name: nuReasoning
tagline: A reasoning-centric long-tail driving dataset of 20-second clips with eight cameras, LiDAR, HD maps and human-verified spatial, decision and counterfactual reasoning annotations.

papers.title: nuReasoning: A Reasoning-Centric Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Tail Autonomous Driving

availability.eligibility: Non-commercial use under the nuScenes Terms of Use; commercial use needs a separate licence from Motional.

evidence.note: Hugging Face API reports gated=auto (terms must be accepted, approval is automatic), public, last modified 2026-09-16.
Project page online; announces the staged release and the nuReasoning Challenge 2026.

download_size.note: Whole current release. A clip is about 2.3 GB (1 GB in the test split).

history.event: Paper and project page published; first clips released on Hugging Face as a mini release.
Full staged release on the Hugging Face Hub (train, val and test); remaining clips announced for after the 2026 challenge.

collection.locations_note: Collected from multiple cities; the record does not yet list them.

scale.notes: 20,000 clips (about 105 hours) are announced; 11,890 clips are released so far. Hours are computed from the released clips.

sensors.name: merged point cloud
sensors.notes: One merged cloud fusing top, front, side-left, side-right and back sensors. Only some clips include LiDAR and none of the test split.

annotations.notes: No published object taxonomy; the devkit lists the categories seen in the data.
Per-frame signal states; the referenced lane can lie outside the clip's map.

annotations.coverage: about one frame per second in train and val
annotations.notes: Spatial, decision and counterfactual reasoning, human-verified.
Ego history and future per frame.
Route command and route path per frame, plus the clip's scenario type.
Challenge questions on the key frame of each test clip.

maps.notes: Not available in the test split.

splits.name: test
splits.notes: Cameras, ego states and route only; no map, boxes, LiDAR or reasoning.

splits.name: mini
splits.notes: Parts 1–3 of train, which include the former mini release.

py123d.notes: Reasoning annotations and challenge questions are passed through as custom modalities.

relations.note: Shares the nuScenes terms of use and sensor conventions.

curation.notes: Cities, camera frequency and the box-labelling method are not recorded yet. The project page states "Accepted to NeurIPS 2025", which conflicts with the 2026 arXiv date; the venue is left as a preprint until confirmed.
